about: Made-up spoken answers to multiple-choice questions in all 23 interface languages, the same ten kinds in each, to measure how well speech-to-text hears each and compare them (the six offered first were added the same day with ids starting h, as voice_answers.json already has en01-style ids): per language, one single-answer and one select-all question and ten answers, all spoken: a letter alone, a letter after a word ('option C'), a read option, a position, two letters, two read options, a yes and a no to a waiting choice, a change while waiting ('no, D'), and an undecided trap. Read aloud by a native-sounding voice, half with noise (build_voice_answers.py --dataset voice_hearing.json), heard by OpenAI or ElevenLabs (voice_answers_test.py --hearing), then matched by rounds' own call; graded by code. Hand-written. 34 text-only traps added 2026-11-07, two per language not in voice_answers.json, each marked `added`: a letter taken back or negated.
